terms.examiner: Higher tier. Units kg m/s; it is a vector.

terms.definition: In a closed system, the total momentum before an event equals the total momentum after.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. Use it for collisions and explosions.

terms.definition: Force = change in momentum ÷ time: F = m Δv / Δt.
Air bags, seat belts, crumple zones and helmets increase the time of impact, reducing the rate of change of momentum and so the force.
